# Kevin Arthur

Kevin Arthur is a design engineer and product designer based in Vancouver, Canada. He designs product interfaces and ships them in React and TypeScript. Open to remote roles in Canada.

## Products

- Varve (https://varve.studio) — free, local-first design suite. Public beta v0.5.0, October 2026. React/TypeScript editor on a Rust/WASM engine. Source-available under FSL-1.1-MIT. Source: https://github.com/K-Arthur/varve · Try: https://varve.studio/try/

## Work

- 2026–present — Founder, designer and engineer, Varve
- 2023–2025 — Product designer for clinical-AI tools at minoHealth AI Labs (Moremi AI, Moremi Collaborate)
